description: Search the Chamber catalog by free text — Chamber two-key JSON seals and the 24-hour try box. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use chamber_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: chamber_search
